scenes.headline: How Cosmos 3 reasons and generates in one sequence
scenes.sub: A reasoner and a video generator sharing one attention operation.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Gizmo! Cosmos 3 is a world model: it plans what to do, and shows you what happens next. Here's how it does both at once.

scenes.text: Put the reasoner and the generator in one token sequence. The generator's queries read the reasoner's keys directly: no text bottleneck.
scenes.say: The idea: put the reasoner and the generator in one token sequence, so the generator reads the reasoner's keys directly. No text prompt in between.

left.title: The usual chain
items: The text becomes a diffusion prompt
left.say: The usual way: a language model writes text, and that text becomes a prompt for a separate video model.

right.title: Mixture-of-Transformers
items: Separate weights per kind of token
One shared attention over one sequence
right.say: Cosmos keeps separate weights for each kind of token, but runs one shared attention over a single sequence.

steps.say: The Reasoner is autoregressive, grown from a vision-language model. Its queries attend causally, over its own keys.
The Generator is a diffusion tower. It denoises video, audio and action latents, in the same sequence.
Its queries attend over the Reasoner's keys and its own, in one operation. So what the Reasoner decided flows straight into the frames.

items.say: The model draws a motion plan on the image itself: a path of waypoints across the frame.
That trajectory conditions the diffusion tower.
So the frames must carry out the motion, not merely look plausible.

scenes.label: task models from one backbone, set by which modalities go in and out
scenes.note: forward dynamics is the simulator an agent can plan against
scenes.say: Because everything is tokens, one backbone becomes six task models, from vision-language to forward and inverse dynamics.

scenes.title: Physical-AI reasoning benchmark
scenes.note: best open model, not best model
scenes.say: It's the best open model on this reasoning benchmark. A closed frontier model still sits above it.

scenes.text: Fuse reasoning and generation inside attention, not through a text prompt, and the plan reaches the pixels.

recap: Two towers, separate weights, one sequence
Generator queries read the reasoner's keys
Plans are drawn as motion on the image
scenes.say: To recap: two towers in one sequence, a generator that reads the reasoner's keys, and plans drawn as motion.
